K Sera Sera Box Office Private Limited vs Venkateshwara
Enterprises on 13 March, 2024 
Author: Bharati Dangre
Bench: Bharati Dangre
2024:Bhc-Os:4314
 1/2 17 Arbap L-18197-20
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Ordinary Original Civil Jurisdiction
 Arbitration Application (L) No. 18197 Of 2023
 K Sera Sera Box Office Private .. Applicants
 Limited & ors
 Versus
 Venkateshwara Enterprises & ors .. Respondents
 ...
 Adv. Sarang Pathak a/w Adv. Abhishek Rane for the applicants. 
 Adv. Yash Joglekar for the respondents. 
 Coram: Bharati Dangre, J.
Dated : 13th March 2024 P.C:-
1  The applicants and the respondents are parties to the Franchise Agreement dated 8/01/2022, and the subsequent agreement of Franchisee Food Business and Safety Agreement as well as the Content Agreement both being executed on the same day,
which contemplate reference of dispute arising therefrom to arbitration.
It is not in dispute that the arbitration was invoked by notice dated 19/05/2023, but no consensus could be arrived as regards the nomination of the sole arbitrator and this is the specific reason why the applicant has approached this Court seeking appointment of a sole arbitrator, to resolve the dispute between the parties. 
 Ashish  2/2 17 ARBAP L-18197-2023 .doc K Sera Sera Box Office Private Limited vs Venkateshwara Enterprises on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16032574/
1 2 Since the counsel for the respondent do not dispute the existence of an arbitration agreement between the parties, and also its invocation, by consent of parties, I deem it appropriate to appoint Justice Anuja Prabhudessai (Retired Judge of Bombay High Court) as a sole arbitrator to resolve the dispute arising out of the three agreements executed on 8/01/2022. 
The Arbitrator shall, within a period of 15 days before entering the arbitration reference forward a statement of disclosure as contemplated u/s.11(8) r/w Section 12 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, to the Prothonotary and Senior Master of this Court to be placed on record. 
The Arbitrator, shall after entering the reference fix the date of first hearing and issue further directions as are necessary. 
The Sole Arbitrator shall be entitled for the fees as per Bombay High Court (Fee Payable to Arbitrators) Rules, 2018 and the arbitral costs and fees of the Arbitrator shall be borne by the parties in equal portion and shall be subject to the final Award that may be passed by the Tribunal. 
All rights and contentions of the parties are kept open. 
3 The order shall be communicated to the Arbitrator by the counsel for the Applicant, forthwith. 
( SMT. BHARATI DANGRE, J.) Ashish K Sera Sera Box Office Private Limited vs Venkateshwara Enterprises on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16032574/

summary.decision:
Since the counsel for the respondent do not dispute the existence of an arbitration agreement between the parties, and also its invocation, by consent of parties, I deem it appropriate to appoint Justice Anuja Prabhudessai (Retired Judge of Bombay High Court) as a sole arbitrator to resolve the dispute arising out of the three agreements executed on 8/01/2022.

The Arbitrator shall, within a period of 15 days before entering the arbitration reference forward a statement of disclosure as contemplated u/s.11(8) r/w Section 12 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, to the Prothonotary and Senior Master of this Court to be placed on record.

The Arbitrator, shall after entering the reference fix the date of first hearing and issue further directions as are necessary.

The Sole Arbitrator shall be entitled for the fees as per Bombay High Court (Fee Payable to Arbitrators) Rules, 2018 and the arbitral costs and fees of the Arbitrator shall be borne by the parties in equal portion and shall be subject to the final Award that may be passed by the Tribunal.

All rights and contentions of the parties are kept open.

3 The order shall be communicated to the Arbitrator by the counsel for the Applicant, forthwith.
